Questions worth answering plainly

What is measured versus a target?

A measured figure was reproduced on MLAI hardware. A target is an engineering goal. The 295× GPU number is a target.

Do you partner with Apple?

Built on Apple's public frameworks — Metal, Accelerate, Core ML.

Where does computation run?

Privacy is a property of where the computation physically runs.

What license is the core?

Apache-2.0. Zig is 0.17-dev.
